status: Part 1 frozen input and evaluation contract; predictive models not yet fitted
development_rule: S0 before 2025-01-01 and label available before 2025-01-01
reserved_test_rule: S0 on/after 2025-01-01; membership fixed before modelling
label_maturity_rule: training label_available_at < earliest validation S0 cutoff; S0 dates must also precede validation
within_fold_policy: Freeze fitted model and preprocessing during each quarter
preprocessing_policy: Training-fold numeric imputation and missing indicators; training-fold scaling for Ridge; no full-data feature selection or label clipping
holdout_policy: Freeze feature choice, model settings and preprocessing policy before evaluating 2025; no tuning on reserved outcomes
online_features_policy: Past already-observable outcomes may update as-of reputation/context during test; no test-target fitting or tuning
honesty_note: All-cohort outcome summaries were viewed during original data preparation; reserved 2025 is not claimed to be unseen external data
scope_note: S0 only. Direct opening-price regression and a separate positive-gain classifier. No guaranteed accuracy or net-profit claims.
classification_rule: Apply if predicted positive-gain probability >= development-selected threshold; initial candidate threshold 0.5
boundary_policy: Keep the original fixed 149 development rows; exclude the single boundary row whose outcome was unavailable at the final cutoff.
